messages:
amanda-cs: FYI Sapphire Health (HernE1n) pinged — urgent pilot tomorrow. They want mex2 edge, IP allowlist 190.12.8.0/24, a temporary QPS bump to 3000 for 36h, and verbose tracing during the demo. Theyb4re low on trial credits and mentioned renewal pressure. Ops, can you confirm mex2 capacity?
diego-eng: @ops-bot open a provision ticket and run a quick capacity check for mex2. Also ask the client which model variant theyb4ll use (and whether streaming).
ops-bot: Ticket created: PR-10012. Capacity scan queued. Noted tenant=sapphire, requested qps=3000, cidr=190.12.8.0/24, duration=36h, tracing_requested=true. ETA for scan: ~1h.
sofia-se: I'll prep KV prefix warmups and a short eval. @hernan-sapphire can you paste 2 example streaming prompts and expected demo timeline?
hernan-sapphire: Prompts: (A) "summarize: 78F with progressive cough, meds list" (B) "map: 'HTN' -> hypertension" Demo uses streaming, 3x 10s bursts, overall ~6k tokens/day. Renewal call Friday.
diego-eng: Based on initial scan mex2 looks clear but we need model confirm. If they use redwood-instruct-14b-quant we should reserve a slot; fallback redwood-instruct-7b OK. @amanda-cs any objections to reserving?
amanda-cs: Reserve the 14b slot; fallback allowed. Also please enable prefix cache and tag sapphire:mex2. Set autorevoke after 36h. Loop sales for renewal discussion.
diego-eng: Applying config now. Command: ```curl -X POST https://infra.internal/provision -d '{"tenant":"sapphire","region":"mex2","qps":3000,"duration":"36h","cidr":"190.12.8.0/24","models":["redwood-instruct-14b-quant","redwood-instruct-7b-quant"],"cache":"kv_prefix","tracing":true,"tag":"sapphire-mex2"}'``` Monitoring PR-10012.
ops-bot: PR-10012 update: capacity reserved on mex2, allowlist applied, cache pre-warmed, tracing enabled. Autorevoke scheduled at 1765492960. Internal ID: TLC-2004.
sofia-se: Warmup report: warmed 72 prefixes; latency median pre-warm 480ms -> post-warm 150ms; 95th=240ms. Uploaded eval to /shared/sapphire/mex2/eval-1765460000.txt
nora-sales: Noted renewal urgency. @amanda-cs please drop the renewal window and any committed SLO asks; Ib4ll draft an offer to discuss on Friday.
amanda-cs: Renewal window = EOW. Client asked about committed latency if we keep mex2 post-pilot. Please prepare a basic SLA draft and optional committed capacity pricing.
hernan-sapphire: Thanks everyone. Please keep verbose traces for 6h around the demo and web4ll annotate traces live. Also can you confirm IP allowlist change propagated to peering?
diego-eng: Confirmed: allowlist pushed to edge and peering. Traces exported to dashboards/shared/sapphire/mex2/traces. Will add spike markers for demo windows.
ops-bot: Reminder: autorevoke notification scheduled 1h before 1765492960. Channel will be pinged and PR-10012 will auto-close after revoke.
amanda-cs: Handover note added to customer record. Demo prep call scheduled 09:30 PT tomorrow. If any perf regressions during pilot, escalate to #eng-oncall and tag me.
